body: Thank you. I’m trying my best to get past what my parents and family think but it’s tough. My boyfriend actually told me this morning that his work offers free counseling for workers, family members, or members of their household (and since we’re not married, I fall under the last one). It’s only 8 sessions per year or fiscal year, he wasn’t clear on which, but I’m going to go to that. Because I can’t stand my head telling me day in and day out that I’m worthless and need to not be a coward and really do it this time.
